mapper.sql: order_id, user_id, show_id, lock_id, movie_title, cinema_name, hall_name, start_time, seat_ids_json, unit_price, amount, seat_price_snapshot, status, ticket_code, qr_payload, pay_channel, expire_at, pay_at, cancel_reason, session_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_ticket ( order_id, user_id, show_id, lock_id, movie_title, cinema_name, hall_name, start_time, seat_ids_json, unit_price, amount, seat_price_snapshot, status, ticket_code, qr_payload, pay_channel, expire_at, pay_at, cancel_reason, session_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{showId}, #{lockId}, #{movieTitle}, #{cinemaName}, #{hallName}, #{startTime}, CAST(#{seatIdsJson} AS jsonb), #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, CAST(#{seatPriceSnapshot} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{ticketCode}, #{qrPayload}, #{payChannel}, #{expireAt}, #{payAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{sessionId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO order_ticket ( order_id, user_id, show_id, lock_id, movie_title, cinema_name, hall_name, start_time, seat_ids_json, unit_price, amount, seat_price_snapshot, status, ticket_code, qr_payload, pay_channel, expire_at, pay_at, cancel_reason, session_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{showId}, #{lockId}, #{movieTitle}, #{cinemaName}, #{hallName}, #{startTime}, #{seatIdsJson}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{seatPriceSnapshot}, #{status}, #{ticketCode}, #{qrPayload}, #{payChannel}, #{expireAt}, #{payAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{sessionId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, expire_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_pay'
UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, expire_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_pay'

UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'issued', ticket_code = #{ticketCode}, pay_channel = #{payChannel}, pay_at = #{payAt}, expire_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_pay'

UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'issued', ticket_code = #{ticketCode}, pay_channel = #{payChannel}, pay_at = #{payAt}, expire_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_pay'
UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'redeemed', updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'issued'
UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'redeemed', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'issued'

UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'expired', cancel_reason = 'pay_timeout', expire_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_pay' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < NOW()

UPDATE order_ticket SET status = 'expired', cancel_reason = 'pay_timeout', expire_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'pending_pay' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ss.movie_id FROM order_ticket ot INNER JOIN show_schedule ss ON ss.show_id = ot.show_id WHERE ot.user_id = #{userId} AND ot.status = 'issued'
